snippet.title: Side Hustle | This Town is Hiding A Very Dark Secret | Short Horror Game
snippet.description:
Side Hustle | This Town is Hiding A Very Dark Secret | Short Horror Game
#newgame #gameplay #gaming #indiegame #horrorgaming #atmospheric  

Buy Game - https://wastyr.itch.io/side-hustle

Welcome to Gary’s Carpet Value.

You open the shop. You flip the sign. You keep things clean.
People trust Gary. They always have.

But lately, there’s been talk.
About what’s really woven into those rugs.

How to play:
WASD - Move 
Mouse - Look around
Left Mouse Button - Interact
Space - Jump
Escape - Open/Close Pause menu

Approx 20 minutes of gameplay
